tweets.text:
i think Grass is an interesting example of where crypto can actually make sense as part of the product

early users contributed resources to help bootstrap the network and received ownership for participating before there was meaningful revenue

as the business matured, that model started shifting toward stablecoin payouts tied to dataset sales

to me, that progression from early ownership to revenue-based rewards is one of the more interesting ways to use crypto for coordinating a network
